text:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up re: chat endpoint partial responses/timeouts. We decided to split actions into detection/alerts, runtime retry logic, and runbook + dashboards. Who can own the runtime retry PR? :wave:

alex: I can take runtime retry PR. ETA end of day Friday (2026-06-26). Will open a draft shortly.

sam: I'll own detection/alerts. Plan: add a 'streaming.partial_response_rate' metric and a PagerDuty rule when >1% over 10m. Will wire Grafana panel.

jordan: I'll update the runbook and add reconnect troubleshooting steps + a sample ws curl sequence for SREs.

infra-bot: deploybot: canary deploy passed on staging (2026-06-20T15:12:03Z) :white_check_mark:

alex: Draft PR posted: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4235 — implements exponential backoff with jitter, max_attempts=3. Preserves KV cache across reconnects; adds client-visible retryable error code.

maria: Important: ensure SDK surface shows 'retrying' vs 'terminal' so product teams can surface UX properly. Also document behavior for streaming SSE vs websocket.

sam: Added alert and Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/streaming/partial-responses — set threshold and test with load-generator this afternoon.

jordan: Runbook updated at https://docs.internal/redwood/runbooks/chat-reconnect.md — includes TL;DR, triage checklist, and escalation path. Scheduling weekly incident review for 4 weeks to catch patterns.

alex: Quick question: should reconnect reuse existing SSE/ws connection or always reopen? I implemented reopen by default; can add keepalive path behind flag.

maria: Reopen is fine for now, but document tradeoffs and add an opt-in feature flag for keepalive behavior.

sam: I'll add a synthetic test that simulates truncated streams and verifies reconnection within 2s and successful token continuity.

maria: Action item summary: runtime PR — alex — 2026-06-26; alerts/metrics — sam — 2026-06-23; runbook — jordan — 2026-06-21; weekly review Wed 09:30 UTC starting 2026-06-24. I'll own coordination and progress tracking. :memo:

alex: Acknowledged. Will post PR updates here.

sam: Acknowledged.

jordan: Acknowledged.

maria: Closing loop: mark incident remediated once synthetic passes for 48h and alert stays below threshold. I'll post status next week.

oncall: oncall: Noted and tagged incident-5702 for tracking.
